scene: The glowing keys unlock three transport gates along the tower terrace.
picture: A flat side-view pixel scene along an outdoor terrace. On the far left, a striped gondola drone floats beside a post. Left of centre, grandmother in her pink tracksuit holds three brass keys while her white dog watches. In the centre, an ornate hover carriage idles. On the far right, a hover metro waits with doors open.
